findings.current: “This old man once served the late Emperor as Grand Preceptor. What is your name?”
findings.defect: The old man identifies himself as someone surnamed Lee; the draft omits his surname.
findings.rationale: 이 모 supplies his surname while leaving his given name unstated.
findings.replacement: “I am Lee, once Grand Preceptor to the late Emperor. What is your name?”
findings.source: “노부는 과거 태사(太師)로서 선황을 섬겼던 이 모라고 하네. 그대의 이름은 무엇인가?”

findings.current: Before long, they had become an army. In their hands were dirt-stained sickles and spears and axes red with rust.
findings.defect: The draft omits the swords among the rusted weapons.
findings.rationale: 창칼 includes both spears and swords.
findings.replacement: Before long, they had become an army. In their hands were dirt-stained sickles, and spears, swords, and axes red with rust.
findings.source: 어느덧 하나의 군세(軍勢)로 거듭난 그들의 손에는 흙 묻은 낫이, 붉게 녹슨 창칼과 도끼가 들려 있었다.

findings.current: Thousands of eyes, sunk deep in their faces, gleamed in the darkness.
findings.defect: The draft turns a subdued, grave expression into a physical description of deep-set eyes and loses the pairs.
findings.rationale: 깊게 가라앉은 describes the cast of their eyes here; 수천 쌍 specifies thousands of pairs.
findings.replacement: Thousands of pairs of solemn eyes gleamed in the darkness.
findings.source: 깊게 가라앉은 수천 쌍의 눈동자가, 어둠 속에서 빛난다.

findings.current: Raise the banner of Crown Prince Zhu Bao, Huangtaidi, and join with those who follow you to eliminate the traitors.
findings.defect: “Huangtaidi” redundantly leaves the title untranslated after “Crown Prince” and makes the command awkward to read.
findings.rationale: The packet’s established rendering of 황태제 in this succession context is “Crown Prince.”
findings.replacement: Raise the banner of Crown Prince Zhu Bao, and together with those who follow you, eliminate the traitors.
findings.source: 그대는 황태제(皇太弟) 주표의 깃발을 들고 그대를 따르는 이들과 함께 역적들을 척결하라.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it omits an identifying surname and changes the sense of one collective image.
